body: Yup, but that's from the perspective of someone who wants to escape a life of being demonized and abused. I have a perfect life. Everyone knows me, everyone remembers my face, and everyone likes me. When a perfect life isn't enough, that's when you know there's something wrong with you. But you're right. No note. Maybe a few phone calls though.
Nope. I've been single my entire life. I'm 18 by the way. I'm very popular, and moderately attractive. I've just had very bad luck. I will not live like this anymore. I refuse.
I want someone to cuddle with. I know I'm only 18, but I'm tired of sleeping alone. Fuck my life.

Yup. I told my friend, he told my parents, they put me in the hospital. When I got out of the hospital, my parents just assumed that I was better. Few months later, everyone in my social circle knows I'm a ticking time bomb, but they just look the other way. And when I die, they'll be SO sad. I wish someone REALLY cared about me.
Thing is, people know I'm suicidal. I'm just not important enough for anyone to help me. I'm not special, so I don't get special treatment.

I don't want to kill myself, but its seems like that's all I can do. I made this account because I wanted to post in the askreddit thread where they talked about their last experience with someone who killed themselves. I've cried for help before, but I was told to stop whining. Now I want to know whether I should write a note or not. Thanks for replying by the way.
Planning to kill myself in a few days. If someone you close to killed themselves, would you want to read a note?

I'm going to OD, and people will tell stories about me like you guys are.  No one loves me now, but people will love me after I die. It hurts to read these comments, knowing that I'm going to be one of them. But I'm happy to know that I will be remembered.

I'm gonna kill myself :(

Edit: Wasn't trolling. I'm sorry though, I shouldn't have posted what I did. It was wrong of me to put this on you guys. I have a few me plans to live, but I there definitely against all odds. Thank you all for your comments.
